Method of Attack: Exploiting CVE-2017-18368, an unauthenticated command injection vulnerability in Zyxel P660HN-T1A routers
Botnet malware takeover via Remote System Log forwarding function exploit
Impacted Systems: Zyxel P660HN-T1A routers running firmware versions 7.3.15.0 v001/3.40(ULM.0)b31 or older
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated command injection vulnerability in Remote System Log forwarding function
